name: Elevoire Website Audit
author: Elevoire

sections.description:
Ever wonder how healthy your WordPress site really is? Elevoire Website Audit acts like a friendly mechanic for your website. It’s a lightweight, completely read-only plugin that runs a comprehensive health check across five critical areas: WordPress core, performance, security, SEO, and accessibility.

Instead of just throwing confusing errors at you, we give you a clear, easy-to-understand health score, along with plain-English explanations of what each finding means and exactly how you can fix it.

We believe in “Look, but don’t touch.”
This plugin will never modify your website. It won’t edit your wp-config.php, it won’t touch your .htaccess, it won’t mess with your file permissions, and it definitely won’t install or deactivate any other plugins or themes. It simply inspects your setup and reports back to you safely.

What we check

  • WordPress Core: We keep an eye on your core version, PHP & database versions, debug mode, cron jobs, object caching, multisite status, auto-updates, and even your permalinks and URL consistency.
  • Performance: We’ll check your page caching, response compression, Heartbeat API frequency, database overhead, and image sizes to make sure your site stays lightning fast.
  • Security: We look for HTTPS, XML-RPC exposure, directory listing vulnerabilities, common HTTP security headers, and default-username risks to keep the bad guys out.
  • SEO: We make sure search engines love you by checking your meta descriptions, robots.txt, XML sitemaps, and indexing status.
  • Accessibility: We check image alt text, HTML language attributes, and heading structures so your site is welcoming to everyone.

Every result comes with a straightforward status (Pass, Warning, Fail, or Info), a severity level, a plain-language summary, and a recommended fix with a link to learn more if you want to dive deeper.

Reports and exports

Need to share the results with a client or your team? You can easily generate a beautiful printable report or export your latest scan as a CSV or JSON file right from the Reports page. Best of all, everything is generated on your own site—nothing is ever sent to a third-party server.

Privacy First

Your data is yours. This plugin doesn’t collect analytics, use tracking, or rely on sneaky telemetry. We never send your data to Elevoire or any third party. A small handful of checks will quietly fetch your site’s public homepage (just like a regular visitor’s browser would) to verify things like security headers and caching, but your scan results never leave your server.

A quick note on the roadmap

For full transparency, the About screen lists some planned Pro modules we’re working on. But don’t worry—none of them are active in this free version, there are zero ads, and we don’t hold any of the free features hostage or nag you to upgrade.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/elevoire-website-audit, or install the plugin directly through your WordPress admin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Head over to Website Audit → Dashboard and click Run Scan to see how your site is doing!
sections.faq:
Is this plugin going to change anything on my site?

Nope! Every single check is strictly read-only. The plugin only stores its own scan results and settings in your WordPress database. It will never edit your content, mess with your configuration files, or touch your other plugins or themes.

Will running these scans slow my site down?

Not at all. The checks only run inside your wp-admin dashboard when you explicitly click “Run Scan” (or on a background maintenance schedule that you completely control). Nothing runs on the front-end, so your visitors’ experience remains as fast as ever.

Does it send my private data anywhere?

Absolutely not. There is no tracking, no telemetry, and no external API usage. The plugin will occasionally request your own site’s public homepage to check things like compression—exactly like a search engine would—but that’s it.

How exactly is my score calculated?

Each category starts with a perfect 100. We deduct points for warnings and failures, weighted by how severe they are (low, medium, high, critical). Your overall score is simply the average of all your category scores. Easy!
